_note: REWRITTEN extension at v2026-08-25. The 04-08 buyer-consent extension (dev.ucp.shopping.buyer_consent) carried four flat, independent booleans (analytics, preferences, marketing, sale_of_data) already registered as DSC-* rows in conformance/requirements/2026-04-08/discounts-consent.json (carried forward by the P1 lane). At 08-25 the SAME capability name is replaced wholesale by a two-level purpose+segment model with source attribution, well-known dev.ucp.consent.* identifiers, data-dependency messaging, and seven numbered normative requirements -- effectively all-new normative text under the old capability name. Filed as a separate file/prefix (CNST) rather than extending DSC-* to avoid colliding with the P1 carry-forward file of the same area; at merge time the maintainer of the full register should decide whether DSC-* (04-08 shape) is superseded/removed for 2026-08-25 or coexists as a deprecated shape note.

rows.requirement: A consent_purpose object MUST include `granted`, `source`, and `description`
rows.notes: REPLACES the 04-08 consent model entirely: 04-08 buyer_consent.json's `consent` object was four independent optional booleans (analytics, preferences, marketing, sale_of_data) with no source/description/segment structure. 08-25 introduces a two-level purpose+segment model. Filed separately from the 04-08 DSC-* carry-forward (see file docstring).

rows.requirement: A consent_segment object MUST include `granted`, `source`, and `description`, and MUST NOT itself carry a nested `segments` member (segments do not nest further)
rows.quote: Overrides the parent's `granted` value for this scope. Segments do not nest further.
rows.notes: consent_segment.json $defs has no `segments` property, unlike consent_purpose; nesting is structurally bounded to one level. (Quote picked from the segment description to disambiguate from the identical required-array text shared with consent_purpose at L11.)
Enum-constrained on both consent_purpose and consent_segment.

rows.requirement: The consent extension is bounded to one level of nesting: purposes have segments; segments do not nest further
rows.quote:
The structure is bounded to one level of nesting: purposes have segments;
segments do not nest further.

rows.requirement: Businesses are responsible for selecting the initial `granted` value according to their applicable policy before advertising consent options; the advertised value with `source: "business"` is the business's authoritative default
rows.quote:
Businesses are responsible for selecting the initial `granted` value according
to their applicable policy before advertising consent options.
rows.notes: Policy-authorship rule; not mechanically checkable beyond confirming a business-sourced default is present.

rows.requirement: `description` and `links` are response-only; the platform does not echo them on confirm. `granted` and `source` are required in both directions
rows.quote:
`description` and `links` are response-only; the platform does not echo them on
confirm. `granted` and `source` are required in both directions:
rows.notes: Checkable by comparing an advertise (response) payload's shape against a subsequent confirm (request) payload's shape.

rows.requirement: On create/update cart and create/update checkout, businesses SHOULD surface missing consent-dependency data (e.g. SMS marketing needing a phone number) as `warning` messages so the platform can collect it on a subsequent operation
rows.quote:
businesses SHOULD surface missing dependencies as `warning` messages so the
platform can collect the data on a subsequent operation.
rows.notes: Directly checkable against messages[] (code: missing_consent_data, example at L341-352).

rows.requirement: On complete_checkout, businesses MUST NOT transition the checkout to `completed` while a confirmed consent decision has unmet data dependencies; missing dependencies MUST be surfaced via the standard Error Handling flow
rows.quote:
businesses MUST NOT transition the checkout to
`completed` while a confirmed consent decision has unmet data dependencies.
rows.notes: Directly checkable end-to-end: confirm SMS marketing consent without a phone number and attempt complete_checkout.

rows.requirement: Businesses MUST advertise the complete set of consent options they support; when presenting a choice, platforms MUST use the advertised `description`, `links`, `granted` value, and purpose/segment grouping
rows.quote:
Businesses MUST advertise the complete
   set of consent options they support. Platforms decide which choices to
   present to the buyer and when; when presenting a choice, platforms MUST
   use the advertised `description`, `links`, `granted` value, and
   purpose/segment grouping.

rows.requirement: Identifiers outside the `dev.ucp.consent.*` namespace are opaque handles; platforms MUST NOT infer semantics from such paths alone
rows.quote:
Identifiers outside the `dev.ucp.consent.*` namespace
   are opaque handles; platforms MUST NOT infer semantics from such paths
   alone.
rows.notes: Continuation of normative requirement #1; namespace-authority-adjacent trust rule for custom purposes/segments.

rows.requirement: When submitting `consent`, platforms MUST include every advertised purpose and segment key, carrying both `granted` and `source` for each; omitting an advertised key within a submitted `consent` map MUST NOT be used to signal any value
rows.quote:
When submitting `consent`, platforms MUST include every advertised
   purpose and segment key, carrying both `granted` and `source` for each.
   Omitting an advertised key within a submitted `consent` map MUST NOT be
   used to signal any value.
rows.notes: Normative requirement #2, second half. Checkable by comparing a confirm payload's key set against the full advertised set.

rows.requirement: Businesses MUST ignore purposes and segments in a request that were not advertised in a prior response; platforms MUST NOT prompt for or transmit purposes or segments the business did not advertise
rows.quote:
Businesses MUST ignore purposes and
   segments in a request that were not advertised in a prior response. Platforms
   MUST NOT prompt for or transmit purposes or segments the business did not
   advertise.
rows.notes: Normative requirement #3 ('Advertised set is authoritative'). Checkable by submitting an un-advertised purpose/segment key and confirming it has no effect.

rows.requirement: For an advertised segment, the segment's `granted` value overrides the parent purpose's `granted` for that segment (more-specific values win)
rows.quote:
For an advertised segment, the segment's
   `granted` value overrides the parent purpose's `granted` for that segment.
rows.notes: Normative requirement #4 ('More-specific values win'); directly checkable against the worked example (L162-210, marketing off but marketing.sms on).

rows.requirement: A consent decision captured with a specific business is attributable only to that business; platforms MUST NOT propagate it as the basis for `source: "platform"` in a different business's request
rows.quote:
platforms MUST NOT
   propagate it as the basis for `source: "platform"` in a different business's
   request.
rows.notes: Normative requirement #6 ('Per-business attribution'); a Platform-side cross-business isolation rule, needs a receiver spanning two businesses to test directly.

rows.requirement: Platforms MAY persist a buyer's prior platform-captured preferences across interactions with the same business and MAY suppress re-presentation of unchanged values; where preferences are persisted, platforms SHOULD give the buyer the ability to change them
rows.quote:
Platforms MAY persist a buyer's prior
   preferences (`source: "platform"`) across interactions with the same
   business and MAY suppress re-presentation of unchanged values.
rows.notes: Normative requirement #7 ('Persistence and reversibility'); Platform-side UX policy.

rows.requirement: This extension defines four well-known purpose identifiers under the `dev.ucp.consent.*` namespace: analytics, marketing, preferences, sale_or_sharing
rows.quote:
| `dev.ucp.consent.analytics`       | Analytics and performance measurement                     |
| `dev.ucp.consent.marketing`       | Marketing communications                                  |
| `dev.ucp.consent.preferences`     | Remembering buyer preferences                             |
| `dev.ucp.consent.sale_or_sharing` | Sale or sharing of personal data with third parties       |
rows.notes: Replaces the 04-08 flat boolean set (analytics/preferences/marketing/sale_of_data) with reverse-DNS purpose identifiers; `sale_of_data` is renamed `dev.ucp.consent.sale_or_sharing`.

rows.requirement: This extension defines two well-known marketing segment identifiers: `dev.ucp.consent.marketing.email` and `dev.ucp.consent.marketing.sms`
rows.notes: Wholly new channel-segment concept; no 04-08 equivalent (04-08 consent had a single flat `marketing` boolean with no channel granularity).
